summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) class with the eleven members in table order; botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config, and adds compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. All 60 tests in test_args.py pass. The full unit suite has 11 failures, identical to the 11 failing on the untouched tree, so they predate this change. Nothing was committed. Judgment calls: booleans from config are passed through raw (no coercion); the SDK::Endpoint bundled-data case is covered by one dedicated test only; the bridge is built with client_config=None; the helper calls the bridge's private lookups _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint.
